in_marathi.name: Shezad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sovereign, Ruler, Powerful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shezad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Originates from the Persian word 'Shejadan', which means 'Sovereign, Ruler, Powerful'. It was a common name among Persian and Arab rulers.
